alt: Scale of daily olive oil intake: measured benefit runs from about 7 g to 20 g; 41 g (Bryan Johnson) and 50 g (PREDIMED) sit beyond the measured range.
Bar chart: oil needed for an equal polyphenol dose and its calorie cost — supermarket 28 g/245 kcal, EU threshold 20 g/177 kcal, Blueprint 12 g/104 kcal, ATTIMO Coratina 6 g/52 kcal.
Row of blue tasting glasses each holding a measured pour of green olive oil.
